Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

OHMmy (development version)

New features

  • New analyze_and_save_clusters() compares clustering methods at the same number of clusters instead of the same resolution value. It finds the cluster numbers that every method produced in its resolution sweep, plots the size of the smallest cluster against the number of clusters (saved as PNG), and returns, for a target number, the highest resolution of each method that gives it. Compared with the first draft of this function:
    • methods are named for any graph (RNA_snn_res.0.5 -> RNA_snn); before, only the .log_snn / .sct_snn naming worked and default Seurat names always failed with “no single number of clusters”;
    • empty factor levels (e.g. after subset()) no longer give a smallest cluster of 0, and columns such as x_res.1_celltype are no longer taken as resolutions;
    • new optional pipelines (compare only some methods) and min_cells_line (the reference line, default 30);
    • the plot is printed only in interactive sessions (no stray Rplots.pdf) and is returned as attr(res, "plot"), with the plotted values in attr(res, "plot_data") and the file path in attr(res, "file");
    • plain-ASCII messages, documentation and tests. For the OHMmy naming (log.fastmnn.log_snn_res.1, sct.fastmnn.sct_snn_res.1), the returned table is unchanged.
  • New cluster_dot_dendro() cuts the group and/or gene dendrograms of plot_dot_dendro_multi() into clusters. The default "inconsistency" method and the "dynamic" method (dynamicTreeCut) cut each branch at its own height, so clusters at different heights are found without choosing a single k or h; "fixed" performs an ordinary cut. Settings can be chosen automatically by silhouette width, unclear leaves stay unassigned (or are assigned with assign_all = TRUE), and group clusters can be written back to the cells of a Seurat object.
  • plot_dot_dendro_multi() attaches the matrix and hclust trees behind its dendrograms to its returned data frame as attributes.
  • ProcessSeuratLOG() and ProcessSeuratSCT() gain force_norm and force_scale (both TRUE by default, which keeps the previous behaviour). With force_norm = FALSE, an existing normalised data layer (LOG) or SCT assay (SCT) is reused instead of being recomputed; with force_scale = FALSE, an existing scale.data layer is reused when it covers the variable features. Missing layers are always computed.

Bug fixes

  • plot_split_dotplots_by_gene_cluster():
    • non-numeric cluster labels (e.g. cell type names) no longer lose the gene ordering or produce coercion warnings; they are labelled gene (<cluster>);
    • n_splits = 1 no longer fails, and no empty plots are written when there are fewer gene-cluster combinations than n_splits;
    • a single condition no longer fails (dot plots are saved without a dendrogram);
    • duplicated gene x cluster x condition rows are averaged instead of failing;
    • rows with a missing id_col value are dropped instead of failing.
  • plot_gene_markers_with_dendro():
    • returns NULL with a message when no gene matches, instead of failing;
    • with a single condition, saves and returns the dot plot without a dendrogram;
    • a single string that is not a gene name is now always used as a regular expression (previously only strings containing ^, $ or | were, so e.g. "GZM" or "HLA-D[PQR]" matched nothing);
    • the dendrogram leaves now line up exactly with the dot-plot rows in the combined figure;
    • an invalid dendro_side gives an error instead of silently using "right".
  • Both functions give a clear error naming any missing required column. Output for inputs that already worked is unchanged.
  • FindTopMarkersAndHeatmap(use_sct = TRUE) now works on SCT objects that were subset after SCTransform()/PrepSCTFindMarkers(). In that situation PrepSCTFindMarkers() skips re-correction and every FindMarkers() test failed with “Object contains multiple models with unequal library sizes”, followed by “object ‘pct.1’ not found”. The function now detects this and uses the existing corrected counts (recorrect_umi = FALSE), as Seurat recommends for subsets.
  • FindTopMarkersAndHeatmap() warns and returns without writing files when Seurat finds no markers at all, instead of failing with “object ‘pct.1’ not found”. When markers are found but none passes the thresholds, it now warns, returns heatmap = NULL and still writes the marker tables (previously it failed with “‘names’ attribute [3] must be the same length as the vector [0]”).

Ambient RNA (SoupX)

  • run_soupx_post_clustering() now builds the final Seurat objects from the counts corrected with the requested methods and pCut. Before, these were computed and then discarded, and the final objects always used SoupX’s default method. create_final_seurat() gains an optional corrected_list argument for this (default NULL, which keeps the previous behaviour).
  • estimate_contamination(): if SoupX::autoEstCont() fails for one sample, a warning is issued and that sample continues with an estimated rho of 0, instead of stopping the whole run. A final contamination fraction above 0.5 (from a large mulFac) is applied with a warning instead of being refused by SoupX; above 1 is a clear error.
  • load_counts() also reads Cell Ranger v2 directories (genes.tsv) and uncompressed files.
  • create_seurat_for_clustering() (and so prepare_soupx_inputs()) no longer fails on samples with 50 or fewer cells or variable features: the number of PCs and UMAP neighbours is capped to what the sample supports.

Clustering

  • ClusterAndUMAP():
    • algorithm is now also used for the final clustering (it was only used for the resolution sweep);
    • when the UMAP already exists, final_resolution is now made the active clustering (seurat_clusters and Idents); before, whichever resolution the sweep ran last stayed active;
    • resolutions with different numbers of decimals (e.g. c(0.25, 0.5, 1)) are now matched to the column names Seurat creates (RNA_snn_res.0.5, not RNA_snn_res.0.50), so they are no longer re-computed on every run.

Statistics

  • plot_metadata_stats() counts every sample once. When a metadata value varies within a sample, the sample was counted once per distinct value; it now uses the first value and warns.
  • plot_cell_abundance(): when a sample appears under more than one condition, its proportions are computed within each sample x condition (so they sum to 1 in each), with a warning. Before, they were split across conditions.

Visualisation and diagnostics

  • make_cluster_palette(): the "kelly" palette no longer repeats colours or includes a near-white colour above 20 clusters, and "polychrome" no longer repeats colours above 17 clusters. Colours for smaller numbers of clusters are unchanged.
  • plot_gene_pair_correlations() gains min_cells (default 3). Clusters with fewer cells get an NA correlation; before, a cluster with two cells always showed a correlation of +/-1.
  • plot_blend_nebulosa() works on Seurat v5 objects with split layers (it failed with “GetAssayData doesn’t work for multiple layers”), and a numeric min_cutoff is now applied as an expression value (it was silently ignored).
  • plot_technical_contribution() and plot_stacked_technical_contribution() no longer fail when n_top_genes / gene_depths ask for more genes than the PCA loadings contain.
  • plot_pc_metadata_correlation() skips non-numeric metadata columns with a warning (it failed with “‘y’ must be numeric”).
  • generate_and_save_heatmap() drops genes with constant expression across the samples (with a message) instead of failing during row scaling.
  • plot_dot_dendro_split() and plot_dot_dendro_multi() return NULL with a message when fewer than two genes or groups remain, instead of failing in hclust().
  • For inputs that already worked, output is unchanged.

Improvements

Analysis quality

  • run_global_gsea() gains rank_by. The default "avg_log2FC" ranks genes by fold change as before; "signed_p" ranks by sign(avg_log2FC) * -log10(p) (using p_val, or p_val_adj if absent), which combines direction and significance and gives far fewer tied ranks.
  • run_global_ora() gains universe, the background gene set for the test. The default NULL keeps using the genes in ORA_df, which is only a valid background when the table contains every tested gene, not just the significant ones.
  • FindTopMarkersAndHeatmap() now shows every top marker in the heatmap. Markers missing from scale.data (non-variable genes) were silently dropped by DoHeatmap(); they are now scaled for the heatmap only (Pearson residuals for SCT), with a message. Genes that were already shown keep the same values.

Robustness

  • CleanSeuratReductions() no longer overwrites a reduction that already has the clean name (e.g. renaming pca.log when pcaLog exists). It keeps both and warns.

Plots are returned consistently

Every plotting function now gives you the plots it saves, without changing what it returned before:

  • plot_split_dotplots_by_gene_cluster() returns list(dendrogram, dotplots), and plot_violin_qc_single() returns list(qc, genes). Both returned NULL before.
  • Functions that return data or file paths attach their plots as an attribute:
    • attr(x, "plots") on the results of run_global_ora() and run_global_gsea() (a named list of every saved plot) and of plot_dot_dendro_multi() (combined, dotplot, row_dendrogram, col_dendrogram);
    • attr(x, "plot") on the results of plot_technical_contribution(), plot_stacked_technical_contribution(), plot_pc_metadata_correlation() (a pheatmap object, plus the correlation matrix as attr(x, "cor_matrix")) and generate_and_save_heatmap() (a gtable).
  • plot_technical_contribution() now returns its value invisibly. Because the value now carries an attribute, compare it with length(x) == 0 rather than identical(x, character(0)).

Maintenance

  • plot_metadata_stats() uses after_stat() instead of the deprecated ..p.format..; the labels are unchanged. plot_cell_abundance() keeps ..p.., which ggpubr (>= 1.0) converts to after_stat() itself (an after_stat() version of that label is mangled by ggpubr and fails).
  • .blend_feature_plot_v5() no longer falls back to Seurat’s deprecated slot argument. OHMmy now requires SeuratObject (>= 5.0.0) and ggplot2 (>= 3.3.0).

OHMmy 1.0.2

Bug fixes

  • process_soupx_samples() no longer fails with “sc must be an object of type SoupChannel”; it now chains prepare_soupx_inputs() and run_soupx_post_clustering() and returns the same structure.
  • run_soupx_post_clustering() now honours manual_contam: when sample names are given, multiFac is added only to those samples (previously it was applied to all samples). estimate_contamination() log messages now describe the mode correctly.
  • plot_pc_metadata_correlation() no longer writes an empty JPEG when another graphics device is open (knitr, RStudio plot pane). Metadata columns that do not exist are skipped with a warning.
  • score_consensus(method = "gmm") now works without attaching mclust; before, the fit failed silently and fell back to fixed_cut.
  • plot_dot_dendro() and plot_dot_dendro_split() create output_dir if it does not exist.
  • ProcessSeuratLOG()’s default integration_method is now the string "HarmonyIntegration" (the previous default was a function and errored). FastMNN integration now uses batch_col instead of a hard-coded batch column.
  • generate_volcano_trio(), generate_and_save_heatmap(), run_global_gsea(), plot_blend_nebulosa() and plot_combined() no longer depend on packages being attached by the user. Missing optional packages give an informative error.
  • run_global_gsea() and run_global_ora() accept output_dir with or without a trailing slash.
  • plot_cell_abundance(global_test = "anova") and plot_metadata_stats() with continuous_test_n3 = "anova" no longer fail when filtering the ANOVA results.
  • plot_metadata_stats() skips metadata_vars that are not in the metadata (previously it errored before reaching its skip check).
  • ProcessSeuratLOG() and ProcessSeuratSCT() check integration_method before any computation and give a clear error for unsupported values.

Improvements

  • plot_cluster_distributions() defaults no longer point to a personal path: cluster_col = "seurat_clusters", batch_col = "orig.ident", output_dir = "Plots_cluster_distributions".
  • generate_and_save_heatmap() also accepts a plain expression matrix and returns the saved file path invisibly. generate_dimheatmaps() returns the failed PC windows invisibly.
  • plot_stacked_technical_contribution() orders facets numerically (PC_1, PC_2, …).
  • plot_violin_qc_single() uses width for both saved figures.
  • ProcessSeuratLOG() and ProcessSeuratSCT() share internal helpers; functions no longer call library(), require() or install.packages() internally.
  • Documentation corrected and expanded throughout; all vignettes rewritten to run end to end on the pbmc3k dataset.
